english.note: Use this colloquial pattern when describing two conditions or types of terrain that keep varying or alternating.

exampleSentences.english: As I drive along this road, I alternate between flat and steep stretches, so I have to be careful.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢條路一時平一時斜，揸車要好小心。
